title: Read-only accounts
desc: Create accounts that can view status, logs and configuration but cannot change anything, download backups or read secrets. Useful for family members or colleagues. Read-only accounts have no two-step verification, so give them unique passwords.
resetPrompt: New password for {name} (at least 8 characters). Existing sessions of this account are signed out.
deleteConfirm: Delete account "{name}"? Its sessions are signed out immediately.
